calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-13-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Judge Wallace Douglass, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong.
Petitioner: Nina Zinterhofer Stanford, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Chase Amelia Stanford and Chloe Zinterhofer Stanford, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Chase Amelia Zinterhofer Stanford and Chloe Madsen Zinterhofer Stanford.
Decree signed in open court.
